root_text:
Five years after the COVID-19 outbreak, China has reported cases of human metapneumovirus (HMPV), a respiratory RNA virus first identified in 2001.

The virus spreads through respiratory droplets and close contact.
Cont.

Five years after the COVID-19 outbreak, China has reported cases of human metapneumovirus (HMPV), a respiratory RNA virus first identified in 2001.

The virus spreads through respiratory droplets and close contact.
Cont.

nodes.author: ManglaniKisore
nodes.text:
Primarily affecting children, the elderly
immunocompromised individuals,symptoms ranging from mild cold-like conditions to severe bronchitis and pneumonia.
HMPV has an incubation period of 3-5 days, evades strong immune responses, and is most active during winter and spring.
